subject: MSA redlines: security exhibit & audit evidence schedule
messages:
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@bluepeakhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tomas Reed <tomas.reed@bluepeakhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Security exhibit questions and evidence cadence for MSA

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again — procurement is wrapping the MSA review and we need to confirm a few items in the security exhibit related to audit rights and evidence delivery so we can close by the end of the month. Our main asks:

- SOC 2: how and how quickly can you provide the SOC 2 report and any supporting artifacts (e.g., control evidence, exception logs) when BluePeak is undergoing its own audits?
- Pen test: do you allow customer-initiated pen tests or a vendor-run test with shared results? What lead time is required and what scope restrictions do you require?
- Audit rights: we need clarity on what "audit right" means in practice — frequency, notice, and whether a third-party assessor can access evidence.

I'm attaching our audit requirements spreadsheet so you can map answers to the contract language. Procurement has a hard deadline of 2026-08-31 for final MSA terms. Can you confirm by EOD Monday 8/23?

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Green
Head of Compliance, BluePeak Health
attachments: BP_Audit_Requirements.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@bluepeakhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions and evidence cadence for MSA

Samantha — thanks for the clear list and the spreadsheet. Looping in Marissa and Laura to keep contract/CS/SE aligned. High level proposals from our side so you have something concrete to review:

- SOC 2: we can provide our latest Type II report on request and commit to delivering it within 7 business days of a written request during the contract term. For supporting artifacts, we can provide exportable evidence snapshots (read-only) on a 30-day cadence for the first 90 days post-activation, then quarterly thereafter.

- Pen test: Redwood performs annual internal pen tests and can provide redacted executive summaries to customers. For BluePeak-initiated testing, we prefer a vendor-managed approach (Redwood coordinates and signs an NDA with the third party) — we can offer a customer-sponsored SOW with a minimum 45–60 day lead time and agreed scope. Full raw exploit data is handled case-by-case.

- Audit rights: we are open to an annual third-party assessment with a single full-access audit per 12-month period (with 30–60 days' notice). For continuous evidence access, we propose a secure, read-only portal / data extracts rather than unrestricted access.

I've attached our current security exhibit draft so Laura can mark legal redlines back to you. If these high-level compromises are acceptable, Laura can bake them into redline language.

Next steps: Laura to provide redlines by 8/24; I'll follow up with Marcus for feasibility/timeline.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v2.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@bluepeakhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions and evidence cadence for MSA

Thanks — I've reviewed the proposed language and attached a marked-up security exhibit. High-level legal comments:

1) Audit right: we cannot agree to unrestricted or continuous onsite audits. Proposed language: one (1) full-scope third-party audit or assessment per 12-month period, with Customer providing at least thirty (30) days' written notice. Any additional requests for access should be limited to material incidents and subject to mutual agreement.

2) SOC 2 access: Redwood will provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and reasonably requested supporting artifacts; we propose a delivery window of 5 business days for the report and a defined set of supporting artifacts produced on a documented cadence (we'll define the artifact list in an appendix).

3) Penetration testing: Redwood will (a) provide a redacted executive summary of vendor testing performed by Redwood; (b) permit Customer-solicited testing subject to a mutually agreed SOW, scope restrictions, and a 60-day notice period. Any testing that could materially impact service availability must be planned and executed outside peak windows.

Please see my redlines in the attached exhibit where I've tried to translate the compromise language into contract text. Samantha — if there are specific items in the BP_Audit_Requirements spreadsheet that are not covered by the exhibit, flag them and we will call them out explicitly.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v3.docx

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@bluepeakhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tomas Reed <tomas.reed@bluepeakhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions and evidence cadence for MSA

Laura / Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and the redline. A few clarifications from procurement/compliance side:

- BluePeak cannot accept a limitation that effectively prevents a third-party assessor from obtaining evidence required for our own SOC 2 audit. We need a mechanism for our auditor (or a mutually agreeable third party) to obtain copies of control artifacts under an NDA.
- The 30-day notice for a full audit is okay, but we need an ability to request ad-hoc extracts (logs, retention reports, configuration snapshots) with a 7-business-day turnaround during our annual audit window.
- For pen tests, BluePeak prefers to run its own vendor (we will share the SOW). We can accept vendor-managed coordination if Redwood signs a mutual SOW/NDA and agrees to a 45-day scheduling window.

Procurement deadline remains 2026-08-31. Can you confirm whether Redwood can include the 7-business-day ad-hoc extract commitment in the exhibit, or if we need a separate addendum?

Thanks,
Samantha
attachments: BP_Audit_Requirements.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@bluepeakhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2026 11:10:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions and evidence cadence for MSA

Samantha — appreciate the specifics. To propose a practical compromise so procurement can close:

1) SOC 2 report: Redwood will deliver the latest Type II within 5 business days of written request.
2) Ad-hoc extracts: Redwood will commit to providing requested artifact extracts (logs, retention/config snapshots, change control records) within 7 business days during the Customer's audit window (limited to a reasonable number of requests — e.g., 5 per 12 months — so we don't create operational risk). We'll enumerate the types of artifacts in an exhibit appendix.
3) Pen test: Redwood agrees to a customer-supplied vendor under a mutual SOW/NDA with a 45–60 day schedule window. Redwood will provide a redacted report and executive summary; raw exploit data will require a separate data-sharing agreement.

If BluePeak agrees to the above, Laura will incorporate the language as an exhibit addendum (or we can create a short addendum if you prefer). Can we aim for final redlines by Thursday 8/27 so Purchasing can finish signatures by 8/31?

I'll also coordinate with Marcus to confirm the artifact list and operational turnaround.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 13:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions and evidence cadence for MSA

Laura / Karthik — quick tech confirmation on feasibility:

- SOC 2 report: we can export and deliver the Type II PDF within 3–5 business days of request.
- Artifact extracts: engineering can produce the listed artifacts (logs, config snapshots, retention proof, deployment manifests) as read-only exports. Monthly or ad-hoc (7 business days) during audit window is doable, but we ask the limit of up to 5 ad-hoc requests per rolling 12-month period to balance operational load.
- Pen tests: supporting an external customer-supplied tester is fine provided we review the SOW and agree on testing windows; 60 days is safer to coordinate scheduling, but 45 could work in some cases with prioritized planning.

I'll prepare a short operations note listing exact artifact types and the export process for Laura to attach to the exhibit.

— Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
